parameters.question: Using GRAVY and solubility = 1 / (1 + exp(2 * GRAVY)), evaluate the reported original solubility, top 3 solubility-improving single-point mutations and gains, and the exact best mutant sequence and solubility. Solubility values must be within +/-0.005; label wording and formatting may differ.
Compare mutation positions and residue substitutions for equivalence, allowing reordered columns/headers and rows; require solubility_gain values to agree within +/-0.005.
